Our BIGGEST Collaboration yet: @woodhaus2 @ArmoredCG @MrColionNoir @TaranTactical @TetianaGaidar 

We test 9mm to .50 cal on Cybertruck Armored Glass. See the results and Franz' reaction.

We hit up @TaranTactical 's  legendary private shooting range in Simi Valley – the epic 20-acre facility where Hollywood stars like Keanu Reeves & Halle Berry train for blockbuster action scenes (think John Wick prep) and Taran Butler himself has hosted movie firearm training for decades.

Tesla Chief Designer Franz von Holzhausen rolled up with the entire Cybertruck design team, joined by the king of 3-gun Taran Butler, badass competitive shooter and action star Tetiana Gaidar, and gun expert  @ColionNoir we put the upgraded   @ArmoredCyberGlass  windows to the ultimate test: blasting them from 9mm handguns all the way up to .50 cal rifles. 

Does Armored CyberGlass hold up against 9mm up to .50 cal?

Watch the insanity unfold – you won't believe the results!

Big thanks to @ArmoredCyberGlass  @MirroredCyber    for making this possible along with  @TaranTactical   letting us use you range!

Starlink provides an Internet connection in flight that is on par with ground Internet speed & latency


Tesla Owners Silicon Valley (@teslaownersSV)

MrBeast says once enough airlines offer Starlink, he’ll only book those flights: “Extra layover? Don’t care—there’s Starlink. I’ll sit anywhere for it. Starlink is amazing.”

He adds: “Most people haven’t used it, but in Antarctica it was our only signal. On a four-hour drive through rural Africa, we mounted Starlink on the car and had perfect connectivity the whole time.”

On SpaceX: “What Elon Musk is doing will fundamentally advance humanity in unimaginable ways. Someone will go to Mars in our lifetime—I truly believe it.”
